title: Update cross-references in other doc definitions
description: Update design-study, spec, and impl-plan definitions to reference the new arch-design document type in their relationship sections.

title: Update document-structure_standards.md for arch-design
description: Add arch-design to doctype suffix inventory, workflow subdirectories table, and quick reference table.

title: Write arch-design_definition.md
description: Create the new document type definition for architecture design documents. Structural, not compilable. Living document with stale status. Subsumes spec for library/subsystem work.

title: Define refactoring document type or workflow
description: Replacement for using implementation plans for refactoring work. Determine whether refactoring needs its own document type or whether beads issues with an arch-design companion are sufficient. If a document type is needed, define it in folio/doc-definitions/.
acceptance_criteria: Decision documented. If a new type: doc-definition exists, standards updated. If beads-only: beads_standards.md updated with refactoring-specific guidance.

title: Define bug-fix document type
description: Replacement for the deprecated bug-fix plan template in impl-plan_definition.md. The bug-fix plan sections (problem statement, root cause, diagnostic evidence, fix, validation, cleanup) have unique value that beads issues do not replicate. Define a dedicated _bug-fix or _fix-report document type in folio/doc-definitions/.
acceptance_criteria: New doc-definition exists in folio/doc-definitions/. document-structure_standards.md updated with new suffix. impl-plan_definition.md deprecation notice updated to point to the new type.

title: Design arch-design staleness detection process
description: Define a process, skill, or automation to surface when an arch-design document has diverged from the implementation. The arch-design is a living document — stale type definitions or contracts are lies. Need a mechanism (CI check, periodic review, code-change trigger) to detect when the code no longer matches the document.
